# Demo Images

Place your demo images in this folder with these exact names:

## Required Images

| Filename | Description | Recommended Size |
|----------|-------------|------------------|
| `demo-homepage.png` | Homepage screenshot | 1920x1080 |
| `demo-category.png` | Category page view | 1920x1080 |
| `demo-mobile.png` | Mobile responsive view | 375x812 |
| `demo-dark-mode.png` | Dark mode screenshot | 1920x1080 |

## Optional Images

| Filename | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `logo.png` | Main logo for README |
| `architecture-diagram.png` | Architecture diagram |
| `api-flow.png` | API flow diagram |

## How to Add Images

1. Take screenshots of your running application
2. Name them according to the table above
3. Place them in this folder
4. Update references in documentation

## Image Guidelines

- Use PNG format for screenshots
- Use SVG format for diagrams
- Compress images if larger than 2MB
- Ensure sensitive data is redacted
- Maintain aspect ratios
